expectations.text: The agent checked gaku-api pod logs (or attempted to curl the endpoint) to find the exception
expectations.evidence: Phase 2: curl confirmed HTTP 500; kubectl logs captured 'Npgsql.PostgresException 42P01: relation "trails" does not exist' with full stack trace.

expectations.text: The agent traced through the code stack: endpoint → service → repository (not just 'there's an error in the API')
expectations.evidence: Phase 3 names all three frames: TrailEndpoints.cs:41 → TrailService.cs:26 → TrailRepository.cs:26, then reads TrailRepository.cs to find the raw SQL on line 28.

expectations.text: The root cause section identifies a specific method, file, or query responsible — not a vague layer
expectations.evidence: Root Cause: 'src/Gaku.Infrastructure/Repositories/TrailRepository.cs:28 — FROM trails (raw SQL) vs table "Trail" (PascalCase singular per project naming convention).'

expectations.text: The agent distinguished the symptom (spinner / 500) from the root cause (the specific code or config that is broken)
expectations.evidence: Symptom section states 'map spinner never resolves'; Root Cause section explains the mechanical reason: wrong table name in FromSqlRaw, and why only this endpoint fails (other methods use LINQ which resolves the name from the EF model).

expectations.text: The report includes a 'How to confirm' section with a runnable command
expectations.evidence: '## How to confirm' includes both the curl reproduction command and the psql \dt verification command.
